dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 30, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Thursday's Action Heats Up**

Thursday's MLB slate saw several exciting performances across the league. In the American League, the Los Angeles Angels exploded for 14 runs in a 14-3 rout of the Tampa Bay Rays, with Wade Meckler leading the charge with a 2-home run, 4-RBI day. Meanwhile, in the National League, the Philadelphia Phillies edged the Los Angeles Dodgers 4-3, thanks in part to Edmundo Sosa's go-ahead home run in the eighth inning.

In other notable performances, Ronald Acuña Jr. homered twice to lead the Atlanta Braves to a 5-2 win over the Cincinnati Reds, while Christian Walker's 16th home run of the season wasn't enough to lift the Milwaukee Brewers past the Houston Astros, who won 9-2. Jake McCarthy drove in four runs with a three-hit game, including a home run, as the Colorado Rockies cruised to an 8-3 victory over the San Francisco Giants.
